# Collation errors:
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/collation-concepts.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/operators.md

# BigQuery takes und:ci and the empty specification; their messages are unverified.
SELECT COLLATE('a', 'und:cs')
=> error:

SELECT COLLATE('a', 'binary')
=> error:

SELECT COLLATE('a', 'fr')
=> error:

# The documentation spells the message "Collation isn't allowed on argument x ('und:ci'). Use
# COLLATE(arg, '') to remove collation".
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRING) AS (x);
SELECT f(COLLATE('a', 'und:ci'))
=> error:

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRING) AS (COLLATE(x, 'und:ci'));
SELECT f('a')
=> error contains: in return type of user-defined function body is not allowed

# [NOT] IN UNNEST does not support collation.
SELECT COLLATE('a', 'und:ci') IN UNNEST(['A'])
=> error:
